constellations.desc: When unleashing Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11302}Countermeasure: Lumi's Battle Cry!{/LINK}</color>, or when triggering Moondrift Harmony, Linnea gains 6 stacks of the <color=#FFD780FF>Field Catalog</color> effect for 10s. Max 18 stacks. When nearby party members deal Lunar-Crystallize Reaction DMG, consume 1 stack of Field Catalog to increase the DMG dealt. The increase in DMG is equal to 75% of Linnea's DEF.\nAdditionally, when Lumi uses <color=#FFD780FF>Million Ton Crush</color> in her <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11300001}Ultimate Power Form{/LINK}</color>, Linnea can consume up to 5 stacks of Field Catalog. Each stack will increase the DMG dealt by 150% of Linnea's DEF.
constellations.name: Provisional Classification

constellations.desc: Within 8s after triggering Moondrift Harmony, all <color=#80C0FFFF>Hydro</color> and <color=#FFE699FF>Geo</color> party members have their CRIT DMG increased by 40%. Additionally, when Lumi uses <color=#FFD780FF>Million Ton Crush</color> in her <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11300001}Ultimate Power Form{/LINK}</color>, the CRIT DMG of that attack increases by an additional 150%. \n\n<color=#FFD780FF>Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam</color>: When Lumi uses <color=#FFD780FF>Heavy Overdrive Hammer</color> in her <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11300001}Super Power Form{/LINK}</color>, or when she uses <color=#FFD780FF>Million Ton Crush</color> in her Ultimate Power Form, an instance of Moondrift Harmony will be triggered. For this instance of Moondrift Harmony, all <color=#80C0FFFF>Hydro</color> and <color=#FFE699FF>Geo</color> characters in the party will be considered to have applied their Elements in the reaction.
constellations.name: Tidings of Joy and Sorrow

constellations.desc: Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11302}Countermeasure: Lumi's Battle Cry!{/LINK}</color> by 3.\nMaximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.desc: Within 5s after Moondrift Harmony is triggered, increase the DEF of Linnea and your current active character by 25% respectively. When Linnea is on field, the DEF-increasing effect can be stacked.

constellations.desc: Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11305}Memo: Survival Guide in Extreme Conditions{/LINK}</color> increases by 3 Levels.\nMaximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.name: Fairyland's Farewell Gift

constellations.desc: The effects of the Constellation, <color=#FFD780FF>Provisional Classification</color>, are enhanced: When unleashing Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11302}Countermeasure: Lumi's Battle Cry!{/LINK}</color>, or when triggering Moondrift Harmony, Linnea will directly gain the maximum number of <color=#FFD780FF>Field Catalog</color> stacks. When consuming <color=#FFD780FF>Field Catalog</color>, consume twice the original number of stacks, such that the increase in DMG will be boosted to 150% of the original value.\n\n<color=#FFD780FF>Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam</color>: Lunar-Crystallize Reaction DMG dealt by nearby party members is {LINK#N11190007}<color=#FFD780FF>elevated</color>{/LINK} by 25%.

After summoning Lumi, the <color=#FFE699FF>Geo RES</color> of opponents near Lumi will be further decreased by 15%.

If your current active character:\n· Is a Moonsign character: Increase this character's Elemental Mastery.\n· Is not a Moonsign character: Increase Linnea's own Elemental Mastery.
passives.name: Universal Naturalist Archive

passives.desc: When a party member triggers a Hydro Crystallize reaction, it will be converted into the Lunar-Crystallize reaction, with every 100 DEF that Linnea has increasing Lunar-Crystallize's Base DMG by 0.7%, up to a maximum of 14%.\n\nAdditionally, when Linnea is in the party, the party's <color=#FFD780FF>Moonsign</color> will increase by 1 level.
passives.name: Moonsign Benediction: Habitat Survey

passives.desc:
When Linnea is not in combat, the charge time of her <color=#FFD780FF>Aimed Shot</color> is greatly decreased, and she will shoot an <color=#FFD780FF>Ultra Convenient Quick Arrow</color> instead. Different effects will occur depending on the targets hit:
· Specific animals: <color=#FFD780FF>Ultra Convenient Quick Arrow</color> will be transformed into a special "Net" that can capture the essence and form of these animals, using them as a medium to manifest the animal's physical form again. The "Net" can only be used for a limited number of times each week. 
· Ore veins used in forging: Linnea will dispatch Lumi, who will quickly strike at the ore marked by the <color=#FFD780FF>Ultra Convenient Quick Arrow</color>, then collect the dislodged ore. If Lumi is not on the field, Linnea will summon her for a short duration to help obtain the ore.

The DMG dealt to opponents by Linnea's <color=#FFD780FF>Ultra Convenient Quick Arrow</color> is reduced to 20% of her original Charged Arrow. Additionally, after firing a certain number of <color=#FFD780FF>Ultra Convenient Quick Arrows</color> within a short period of time, Linnea needs to take a temporary break before she can continue using them.
passives.name: Master Adventurer

skills.desc:
<color=#FFD780FF>Normal Attack</color>
Performs up to 3 consecutive shots with a bow.

<color=#FFD780FF>Charged Attack</color>
Performs a more precise <color=#FFD780FF>Aimed Shot</color> with increased DMG.
While aiming, stone crystals will accumulate on the arrowhead. A fully charged crystalline arrow will deal <color=#FFE699FF>Geo DMG</color>.

<color=#FFD780FF>Plunging Attack</color>
Fires off a shower of arrows in mid-air before falling and striking the ground, dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
skills.name: Capture Protocol

skills.desc: Adventure with Lumi! Depending on how you Tap, Lumi attacks in different forms. Tap Lumi strikes in a {LINK#N11300001}Super Power Form{/LINK}, attacking nearby enemies continuously, dealing AoE Geo DMG. If there are Moondrifts nearby, Lumi will also deal AoE Geo DMG to nearby enemies, which will be considered Lunar-Crystallize Reaction DMG. Continuous Tapping Time to show what we're really capable of! After using her Elemental Skill, Linnea will feed Lumi sparkling gemstones when her Elemental Skill or Normal Attack is Tapped repeatedly. A full-bellied Lumi will strike in her {LINK#N11300001}Ultimate Power Form{/LINK}, dealing an especially powerful instance of AoE Geo DMG that is considered Lunar-Crystallize Reaction DMG, switching to {LINK#N11300001}Standard Power Form{/LINK}. Additionally, tapping the Elemental Skill increases Linnea's interruption resistance. "You're up, Lumi!"
skills.name: Countermeasure: Lumi's Battle Cry!

hyperlinks.description:
Lumi has three different Strike Forms.

Super Power Form
Lumi will use Pound-Pound Pummeler to attack nearby opponents continuously. Every attack will deal 2 instances of AoE Geo DMG.
If there are Moondrifts nearby, Lumi will alternate between Pound-Pound Pummeler and Heavy Overdrive Hammer to continuously attack nearby opponents . Heavy Overdrive Hammer will deal AoE Geo DMG which will be considered Lunar-Crystallize Reaction DMG.

Ultimate Power Form
Lumi will use the ultimate Million Ton Crush, dealing an especially powerful instance of AoE Geo DMG that is considered Lunar-Crystallize Reaction DMG, switching to Standard Power Form.

Standard Power Form
It might not be as flashy as the other forms, but it still packs a serious punch.
Lumi will use Pound-Pound Pummeler at longer intervals to attack nearby opponents continuously. Every attack will deal 2 instances of AoE Geo DMG.
hyperlinks.name: Lumi: Strike Forms

const2.description: 触发月笼谐奏后的8秒内，队伍中所有元素类型为<color=#80C0FFFF>水元素</color>与<color=#FFE699FF>岩元素</color>的角色的暴击伤害提升40%，且露米在<color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11300001}究极厉害形态{/LINK}</color>下使用<color=#FFD780FF>百万吨重锤</color>的暴击伤害额外提升150%。\n\n<color=#FFD780FF>月兆·满辉</color>：露米在<color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11300001}超厉害形态{/LINK}</color>下使用<color=#FFD780FF>加力重锤</color>时，或在究极厉害形态下使用<color=#FFD780FF>百万吨重锤</color>时，会触发一次月笼谐奏，且本次月笼谐奏视为队伍中所有元素类型为<color=#80C0FFFF>水元素</color>与<color=#FFE699FF>岩元素</color>的角色均在反应中施加了元素。

hyperlinks.description:
露米有三种不同的出击形态。

超厉害形态
露米会使用捶捶乱打不断攻击附近的敌人，每次攻击会造成2次岩元素范围伤害。
若附近存在月笼，露米则会交替使用捶捶乱打与加力重锤，不断攻击附近的敌人；加力重锤会造成视为月结晶反应伤害的岩元素范围伤害。

究极厉害形态
露米会使用究极厉害的百万吨重锤，对附近的敌人造成一次格外强力的、视为月结晶反应伤害的岩元素范围伤害，并切换至普通厉害形态。

普通厉害形态
虽然没有其他形态那么厉害，但也很厉害。
露米会以更长的间隔使用捶捶乱打，不断攻击附近的敌人，每次攻击会造成2次岩元素范围伤害。
hyperlinks.name: 露米·出击形态

p1.description: 露米在场上时，露米附近敌人的<color=#FFE699FF>岩元素抗性</color>会降低15%。\n\n<color=#FFD780FF>月兆·满辉</color>：莉奈娅的元素战技<color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11302}对策·露米呀吼吼！{/LINK}</color>和元素爆发<color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11305}备忘·绝境生存指南{/LINK}</color>获得强化，呼唤露米上场后，露米附近敌人的<color=#FFE699FF>岩元素抗性</color>还会进一步降低15%。
p1.name: 野外观察手记

p2.description: 依据队伍中自己的当前场上角色，莉奈娅会提升队伍中特定角色的元素精通，提升值基于莉奈娅防御力的5%。若队伍中自己的当前场上角色：\n·为月兆角色：提升该角色的元素精通；\n·不为月兆角色：提升莉奈娅自己的元素精通。
p2.name: 万类博物图鉴

p3.description: 队伍中的角色触发水元素结晶反应时，将转为触发月结晶反应，且基于莉奈娅的防御力，提升队伍中角色造成的月结晶反应的基础伤害：每100点防御力都将提升0.7%月结晶反应的基础伤害，至多通过这种方式提升14%伤害。\n\n此外，莉奈娅在队伍中时，队伍的<color=#FFD780FF>月兆</color>将会上升一级。
p3.name: 月兆祝赐·栖地考察

p4.description:
不处于战斗状态下时，莉奈娅进行<color=#FFD780FF>瞄准射击</color>所需的蓄力时间大幅减少，并会转为射出特制的<color=#FFD780FF>超便利快捷矢</color>，依据命中的目标，产生不同的效果。若命中的目标为：
·特定动物：<color=#FFD780FF>超便利快捷矢</color>会转化为特殊的「网」，可以拘出小动物的神形，并以其为媒介，再次化出小动物的形体；每周可使用的「网」数量有限。
·锻造用矿石的矿脉：莉奈娅会派出露米，快速破坏被<color=#FFD780FF>超便利快捷矢</color>标记的矿体，并收集掉落的矿石。若露米不在场上，则会短暂呼唤出露米，帮助莉奈娅获取矿石。

<color=#FFD780FF>超便利快捷矢</color>对敌人造成的伤害降低为原本的20%。此外，短时间内发射一定数量的<color=#FFD780FF>超便利快捷矢</color>后，莉奈娅需要进行短暂的休息，才能继续发射。
p4.name: 大师级的冒险者

elementalburst.description: 就算是大师级的冒险家，也需要适度的休息！莉奈娅呼唤露米以{LINK#N11300001}超厉害形态{/LINK}出击，为附近的队伍中所有角色恢复生命值，并在接下来的一段时间内，持续为附近的当前场上角色恢复生命值，回复量受益于莉奈娅的防御力。 若施放元素爆发时，露米已经出击，则改为重置露米的持续时间，并不会改变露米的出击形态。 「对于专业的冒险家来说，比起前所未有的发现，在绝境中全身而退才是最高法则！」
elementalburst.name: 备忘·绝境生存指南

elementalskill.description: 和露米一起冒险！依据不同的点按方式，露米将会以不同的形态出击。 点按 露米将会以{LINK#N11300001}超厉害形态{/LINK}出击，不断攻击附近的敌人，造成岩元素范围伤害；若附近存在月笼，露米还会对附近的敌人造成视为月结晶反应伤害的岩元素范围伤害。 连续点按 该拿出超厉害的真本事啦！使用元素战技后，连续点按元素战技或普通攻击，莉奈娅将会向露米投喂亮晶晶的宝石，吃得饱饱的露米会以{LINK#N11300001}究极厉害形态{/LINK}出击，对附近的敌人造成一次格外强力的、视为月结晶反应伤害的岩元素范围伤害，并切换至{LINK#N11300001}普通厉害形态{/LINK}。 此外，连续点按元素战技时，提高莉奈娅的抗打断能力。 「就交给你了，露米！」
elementalskill.name: 对策·露米呀吼吼！

normalattack.description:
<color=#FFD780FF>普通攻击</color>
进行至多三段的连续弓箭射击。

<color=#FFD780FF>重击</color>
进行伤害更高、更为精准的<color=#FFD780FF>瞄准射击</color>。
瞄准时，岩晶会在箭矢上持续积聚。聚满了晶岩的箭矢会造成<color=#FFE699FF>岩元素伤害</color>。

<color=#FFD780FF>下落攻击</color>
从空中射出箭雨，并迅速下坠冲击地面，在落地时造成范围伤害。
normalattack.name: 捕获方案

constellations.desc: When unleashing Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11302}Countermeasure: Lumi's Battle Cry!{/LINK}</color>, or when triggering Moondrift Harmony, Linnea gains 6 stacks of the <color=#FFD780FF>Field Catalog</color> effect for 10s. Max 18 stacks. When nearby party members deal Lunar-Crystallize Reaction DMG, consume 1 stack of Field Catalog to increase the DMG dealt. The increase in DMG is equal to 75% of Linnea's DEF.\nAdditionally, when Lumi uses <color=#FFD780FF>Million Ton Crush</color> in her <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11300001}Ultimate Power Form{/LINK}</color>, Linnea can consume up to 5 stacks of Field Catalog. Each stack will increase the DMG dealt by 150% of Linnea's DEF.
constellations.name: Provisional Classification

constellations.desc: Within 8s after triggering Moondrift Harmony, all <color=#80C0FFFF>Hydro</color> and <color=#FFE699FF>Geo</color> party members have their CRIT DMG increased by 40%. Additionally, when Lumi uses <color=#FFD780FF>Million Ton Crush</color> in her <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11300001}Ultimate Power Form{/LINK}</color>, the CRIT DMG of that attack increases by an additional 150%. \n\n<color=#FFD780FF>Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam</color>: When Lumi uses <color=#FFD780FF>Heavy Overdrive Hammer</color> in her <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11300001}Super Power Form{/LINK}</color>, or when she uses <color=#FFD780FF>Million Ton Crush</color> in her Ultimate Power Form, an instance of Moondrift Harmony will be triggered. For this instance of Moondrift Harmony, all <color=#80C0FFFF>Hydro</color> and <color=#FFE699FF>Geo</color> characters in the party will be considered to have applied their Elements in the reaction.
constellations.name: Tidings of Joy and Sorrow

constellations.desc: Increases the Level of <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11302}Countermeasure: Lumi's Battle Cry!{/LINK}</color> by 3.\nMaximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.name: Eventful Log Page

constellations.desc: Within 5s after Moondrift Harmony is triggered, increase the DEF of Linnea and your current active character by 25% respectively. When Linnea is on field, the DEF-increasing effect can be stacked.
constellations.name: Expert Instinct

constellations.desc: Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11305}Memo: Survival Guide in Extreme Conditions{/LINK}</color> increases by 3 Levels.\nMaximum upgrade level is 15.
constellations.name: Fairyland's Farewell Gift

constellations.desc: The effects of the Constellation, <color=#FFD780FF>Provisional Classification</color>, are enhanced: When unleashing Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11302}Countermeasure: Lumi's Battle Cry!{/LINK}</color>, or when triggering Moondrift Harmony, Linnea will directly gain the maximum number of <color=#FFD780FF>Field Catalog</color> stacks. When consuming <color=#FFD780FF>Field Catalog</color>, consume twice the original number of stacks, such that the increase in DMG will be boosted to 150% of the original value.\n\n<color=#FFD780FF>Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam</color>: Lunar-Crystallize Reaction DMG dealt by nearby party members is {LINK#N11190007}<color=#FFD780FF>elevated</color>{/LINK} by 25%.
constellations.name: Golden Beagle's Dream

passives.desc: When Lumi is present on the field, the <color=#FFE699FF>Geo RES</color> of opponents near Lumi will decrease by 15%.\n\n<color=#FFD780FF>Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam</color>: Linnea's Elemental Skill <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11302}Countermeasure: Lumi's Battle Cry!{/LINK}</color> and Elemental Burst <color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11305}Memo: Survival Guide in Extreme Conditions{/LINK}</color> are enhanced. After summoning Lumi, the <color=#FFE699FF>Geo RES</color> of opponents near Lumi will be further decreased by 15%.
passives.name: Field Observation Notes

passives.desc: Linnea will increase the Elemental Mastery of certain characters in your party according to your current active character. Increase in Elemental Mastery is based on 5% of Linnea's DEF. If your current active character:\n· Is a Moonsign character: Increase this character's Elemental Mastery.\n· Is not a Moonsign character: Increase Linnea's own Elemental Mastery.
passives.name: Universal Naturalist Archive

passives.desc: When a party member triggers a Hydro Crystallize reaction, it will be converted into the Lunar-Crystallize reaction, with every 100 DEF that Linnea has increasing Lunar-Crystallize's Base DMG by 0.7%, up to a maximum of 14%.\n\nAdditionally, when Linnea is in the party, the party's <color=#FFD780FF>Moonsign</color> will increase by 1 level.
passives.name: Moonsign Benediction: Habitat Survey

passives.desc:
When Linnea is not in combat, the charge time of her <color=#FFD780FF>Aimed Shot</color> is greatly decreased, and she will shoot an <color=#FFD780FF>Ultra Convenient Quick Arrow</color> instead. Different effects will occur depending on the targets hit:
· Specific animals: <color=#FFD780FF>Ultra Convenient Quick Arrow</color> will be transformed into a special "Net" that can capture the essence and form of these animals, using them as a medium to manifest the animal's physical form again. The "Net" can only be used for a limited number of times each week. 
· Ore veins used in forging: Linnea will dispatch Lumi, who will quickly strike at the ore marked by the <color=#FFD780FF>Ultra Convenient Quick Arrow</color>, then collect the dislodged ore. If Lumi is not on the field, Linnea will summon her for a short duration to help obtain the ore.

The DMG dealt to opponents by Linnea's <color=#FFD780FF>Ultra Convenient Quick Arrow</color> is reduced to 20% of her original Charged Arrow. Additionally, after firing a certain number of <color=#FFD780FF>Ultra Convenient Quick Arrows</color> within a short period of time, Linnea needs to take a temporary break before she can continue using them.
passives.name: Master Adventurer

skills.desc:
<color=#FFD780FF>Normal Attack</color>
Performs up to 3 consecutive shots with a bow.

<color=#FFD780FF>Charged Attack</color>
Performs a more precise <color=#FFD780FF>Aimed Shot</color> with increased DMG.
While aiming, stone crystals will accumulate on the arrowhead. A fully charged crystalline arrow will deal <color=#FFE699FF>Geo DMG</color>.

<color=#FFD780FF>Plunging Attack</color>
Fires off a shower of arrows in mid-air before falling and striking the ground, dealing AoE DMG upon impact.
skills.name: Capture Protocol

skills.desc: Adventure with Lumi! Depending on how you Tap, Lumi attacks in different forms. Tap Lumi strikes in a {LINK#N11300001}Super Power Form{/LINK}, attacking nearby enemies continuously, dealing AoE Geo DMG. If there are Moondrifts nearby, Lumi will also deal AoE Geo DMG to nearby enemies, which will be considered Lunar-Crystallize Reaction DMG. Continuous Tapping Time to show what we're really capable of! After using her Elemental Skill, Linnea will feed Lumi sparkling gemstones when her Elemental Skill or Normal Attack is Tapped repeatedly. A full-bellied Lumi will strike in her {LINK#N11300001}Ultimate Power Form{/LINK}, dealing an especially powerful instance of AoE Geo DMG that is considered Lunar-Crystallize Reaction DMG, switching to {LINK#N11300001}Standard Power Form{/LINK}. Additionally, tapping the Elemental Skill increases Linnea's interruption resistance. "You're up, Lumi!"
skills.name: Countermeasure: Lumi's Battle Cry!

skills.desc: Even master adventurers need proper rest! Linnea summons Lumi to strike in {LINK#N11300001}Super Power Form{/LINK}, healing nearby party members. For a short duration, she will continuously heal nearby active party members based on Linnea's DEF. If Lumi is already on the field when Linnea unleashes Elemental Burst, Lumi's active duration will be reset instead and her Strike Form will not change. "Any professional adventurer worth their salt prizes making it out of a serious jam over making discoveries, however unprecedented!"
skills.name: Memo: Survival Guide in Extreme Conditions

constellations.desc: 施放元素战技<color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11302}对策·露米呀吼吼！{/LINK}</color>时，或触发月笼谐奏时，莉奈娅将获得6层<color=#FFD780FF>「历览编录」</color>效果，该效果持续10秒，至多叠加18层。队伍中附近的角色造成月结晶反应伤害时，将消耗一层「历览编录」，提升造成的伤害，提升值相当于莉奈娅防御力的75%。\n此外，露米在<color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11300001}究极厉害形态{/LINK}</color>下使用<color=#FFD780FF>百万吨重锤</color>时，莉奈娅可以消耗至多5层「历览编录」，每层都会使造成的伤害提升，提升值相当于莉奈娅防御力的150%。
constellations.name: 未完成的分类

constellations.desc: 触发月笼谐奏后的8秒内，队伍中所有元素类型为<color=#80C0FFFF>水元素</color>与<color=#FFE699FF>岩元素</color>的角色的暴击伤害提升40%，且露米在<color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11300001}究极厉害形态{/LINK}</color>下使用<color=#FFD780FF>百万吨重锤</color>的暴击伤害额外提升150%。\n\n<color=#FFD780FF>月兆·满辉</color>：露米在<color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#N11300001}超厉害形态{/LINK}</color>下使用<color=#FFD780FF>加力重锤</color>时，或在究极厉害形态下使用<color=#FFD780FF>百万吨重锤</color>时，会触发一次月笼谐奏，且本次月笼谐奏视为队伍中所有元素类型为<color=#80C0FFFF>水元素</color>与<color=#FFE699FF>岩元素</color>的角色均在反应中施加了元素。
constellations.name: 喜或悲的谕告

constellations.desc: 元素战技<color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11302}对策·露米呀吼吼！{/LINK}</color>的技能等级提高3级。\n至多提升至15级。
constellations.name: 热闹的记录页

constellations.desc: 触发月笼谐奏后的5秒内，莉奈娅与队伍中自己的当前场上角色的防御力分别提升25%。莉奈娅在场上时，上述防御力提升效果可叠加。
constellations.name: 专家的直感觉

constellations.desc: 元素爆发<color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11305}备忘·绝境生存指南{/LINK}</color>的技能等级提高3级。\n至多提升至15级。
constellations.name: 仙乡的赠别礼

constellations.desc: 命之座<color=#FFD780FF>「未完成的分类」</color>的效果获得强化：施放元素战技<color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11302}对策·露米呀吼吼！{/LINK}</color>时，或触发月笼谐奏时，莉奈娅将直接获得最大层数的<color=#FFD780FF>「历览编录」</color>效果；消耗<color=#FFD780FF>「历览编录」</color>时，将消耗原本2倍的层数，并使伤害提升效果提高至原本的150%。\n\n<color=#FFD780FF>月兆·满辉</color>：队伍中附近的角色造成的月结晶反应伤害{LINK#N11190007}<color=#FFD780FF>擢升</color>{/LINK}25%。
constellations.name: 黄金猎犬之梦

passives.desc: 露米在场上时，露米附近敌人的<color=#FFE699FF>岩元素抗性</color>会降低15%。\n\n<color=#FFD780FF>月兆·满辉</color>：莉奈娅的元素战技<color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11302}对策·露米呀吼吼！{/LINK}</color>和元素爆发<color=#FFD780FF>{LINK#S11305}备忘·绝境生存指南{/LINK}</color>获得强化，呼唤露米上场后，露米附近敌人的<color=#FFE699FF>岩元素抗性</color>还会进一步降低15%。
passives.name: 野外观察手记

passives.desc: 依据队伍中自己的当前场上角色，莉奈娅会提升队伍中特定角色的元素精通，提升值基于莉奈娅防御力的5%。若队伍中自己的当前场上角色：\n·为月兆角色：提升该角色的元素精通；\n·不为月兆角色：提升莉奈娅自己的元素精通。
passives.name: 万类博物图鉴

passives.desc: 队伍中的角色触发水元素结晶反应时，将转为触发月结晶反应，且基于莉奈娅的防御力，提升队伍中角色造成的月结晶反应的基础伤害：每100点防御力都将提升0.7%月结晶反应的基础伤害，至多通过这种方式提升14%伤害。\n\n此外，莉奈娅在队伍中时，队伍的<color=#FFD780FF>月兆</color>将会上升一级。
passives.name: 月兆祝赐·栖地考察

skills.desc: 就算是大师级的冒险家，也需要适度的休息！莉奈娅呼唤露米以{LINK#N11300001}超厉害形态{/LINK}出击，为附近的队伍中所有角色恢复生命值，并在接下来的一段时间内，持续为附近的当前场上角色恢复生命值，回复量受益于莉奈娅的防御力。 若施放元素爆发时，露米已经出击，则改为重置露米的持续时间，并不会改变露米的出击形态。 「对于专业的冒险家来说，比起前所未有的发现，在绝境中全身而退才是最高法则！」
skills.name: 备忘·绝境生存指南
